name: gizza-ai/z-score-normalize
summary: Standardize a list of numbers (z-score, min-max, max-abs, robust)

tool.description: Normalize a list of numbers (separated by spaces, commas, semicolons, or newlines). method='z-score' (default) standardizes each value to mean 0 and standard deviation 1 by subtracting the mean and dividing by the standard deviation (population ÷N by default, or sample ÷N−1 when sample=true); method='min-max' linearly rescales values into the 0–1 range; method='max-abs' divides by the largest absolute value, mapping into [−1, 1] while preserving sign; method='robust' subtracts the median and divides by the interquartile range (Q3−Q1) to resist outliers. Returns the transformed values plus the parameters used (mean/std dev, min/max, max abs, or median/IQR). Runs locally.

numbers.description: The numbers to normalize, separated by spaces, commas, semicolons, or newlines.

method.description: 'z-score' (default) standardizes to mean 0 and standard deviation 1; 'min-max' rescales linearly into the 0–1 range; 'max-abs' divides by the largest absolute value, mapping into [−1, 1] while preserving sign; 'robust' subtracts the median and divides by the interquartile range (Q3−Q1), resisting outliers.

sample.description: z-score only: when true use the sample standard deviation (÷N−1); default false uses the population standard deviation (÷N), matching scikit-learn StandardScaler. Ignored for the other methods.
